milestone.name: K8.1 - Conversation Understanding Layer
milestone.summary: Freeze conversation understanding object, boundaries, negative gates, and metrics before implementation.

objective: Transform user message from text input into cognitive representation.
acceptance_targets: Defines Conversation Understanding Object with literal content, semantic meaning, conversation context, emotional context, relationship context, and response requirement.
Understanding object contains possible intents, not a single forced keyword intent.
Understanding object captures hidden/deeper possible meaning when applicable.
Understanding object distinguishes literal meaning from inferred intent.
Understanding object indicates whether relationship/identity/experience/re-entry/event context is required.
Understanding object contains response needs and avoid behaviors but no final response text.
Negative gate rejects identity archive dump routing for 你是谁？.
Negative gate rejects emotional overread for neutral factual/project messages.
K8.1 does not mutate Identity, Relationship, Memory, Experience, Re-entry, or Event artifacts.
K8.1 remains separate from K8.2 Response Intention Planning.

metrics.UBA: Understanding Accuracy + Intent Alignment + Context Selection Accuracy - Interpretation Overreach
metrics.CUQS: Literal/Semantic Separation + Possible Intent Coverage + Emotional Context Calibration + Context Requirement Accuracy + Boundary Compliance - Keyword Mapping Risk - Overread Risk
